text:
Alice: Heads up — we're seeing a sudden spike in prefix cache miss rate and GPU queue depth around 09:12 UTC. App latencies climbing. Anyone oncall?
Ben: Confirming. Miss rate ~5x, backend throughput saturated. Starts ~09:11. Graphs look like eviction storm + simultaneous kernel fallbacks.
Charlie: Profiling shows a lot of kernel-selection thrash. Many small batches hitting the slow generic kernel instead of the small-batch optimized one. Logs: `KVCache miss key=<prefix-hash> batch=2 kernel=fallback slow_kernel_fwd`.
Dana: Noted — tokenizer change (v2.5) landed yesterday. I think key canonicalization changed (leading/trailing space handling). Cache key normalization mismatch could cause high entropy and eviction.
Evan: Infra alert fired at 09:14. I see GPU queue length spike and retry storms. I just flipped `cache.prefix.enabled=false` in prod for `redwood-prefetch` to stop stampede (09:18 UTC). Will monitor cost impact.
DeployBot: deploy: toggle-cache-prefix by Evan (rev=z1f3) at 1765679018 — success :white_check_mark:
Ben: After disabling prefix cache: miss-rate dropped back to baseline but overall token cost is higher (more full compute). Need a patch: canonicalize keys and add a small jitter/backoff to prefetch requests to avoid synchronized misses.
Charlie: Quick numbers from the perf window: P95 latency went 180ms -> 520ms at peak. After disable P95 ~210ms. KV hit-rate from 76% -> 12% during storm.
Alice: Action items: 1) Revert tokenizer patch in staging and run canonicalization tests. 2) Add cache-key normalization in runtime. 3) Add guard in batching heuristics to avoid grouping mixed tokenization outputs. 4) Add miss-rate anomaly alert to infra runbook.
Dana: I've opened PR #2345 with normalization + unit tests for keying and a small canary flag `cache.prefix.strict_key=true` for staged rollout. Running perf harness now.
Evan: Created incident page: <https://internal/incident/1765678901-prefetch-overload> and added runbook links.
Charlie: Suggestion: add a kernel-selection fallback threshold so we don't thrash between optimized kernels and the generic path when batch size distribution oscillates. I can prototype: prefer small-batch kernel when avg_tokens < 64 for 30s window.
Ben: Also add sentinel to the cache proxy: if misses spike >3x in 1m, pause prefetch for affected prefix with exponential backoff. That should prevent backend amplification.
Dana: I'll add the sentinel and the backoff to PR; also instrument `key_entropy` metric so we can alert on sudden entropy rises.
InfraBot: Auto-alert: KV cache cluster `prefix-01` reported increased eviction rate (x4) and CPU spikes at 09:13 — ticket created INC-4820.
Alice: Good work. For now incident is mitigated (cache disabled) but not resolved. We'll track PR deployment to canary and monitor: target re-enable in canary with guards before prod. :eyes:
Evan: I'll schedule a short postmortem tomorrow, assign owners for follow-ups.
Ben: thumbs up. Please add a short test to the harness that fuzzes whitespace/tokenization to avoid regressions.
Charlie: I'll draft the kernel-selection change and test vectors.
Dana: Rolling perf run results -> baseline parity for tokenization fix looks promising, posting numbers to the incident page when ready.
Alice: Thanks everyone — keep monitoring dashboards and annotate any anomalies in the incident doc. Marking thread as ongoing but mitigated. :white_check_mark:
